scope: Mathematical source-to-statement review only; root supplies actual Lean build/kernel/axiom evidence.

reviewed_claims.result: The actual feasible reward supremum uses exactly the source mixture family p in[0,1]. Interior optimal value, actual derivative50/3 and actual dual-price minimizer/uniqueness are proved; the derivative does not assume the desired budget sensitivity.
assumptions: Source two-mode model and discount.9; budget strictly between pure-mode cost bounds for derivative and unique multiplier.
reviewed_claims.semantic_bridge: CoreEntryModel derives the actual0/1 entry indicator law through PMF.bind of mode choice and conditional Bernoulli entry; pathwise expected discounted indicator return equals the mode-average cost. This closes the earlier distinction between a random indicator and its conditional expectation.
reviewed_claims.remaining_review: Root should reference both reward-return and actual entry-indicator-return bridges in the complete B1 mapping, and direct p=.25/value identities in CompleteCoreBook.

reviewed_claims.result: CoreReturns proves constant-cost discounted budget equivalence and doubling between .9 and .95. This supports the changed operational interpretation. CoreEntryModel gives actual indicator return at arbitrary |gamma|<1; no temporal independence is required for expectation interchange.
assumptions: The source stationary policy has the same per-time mode/entry marginal law; bounded rewards/costs; probability measure; |gamma|<1.
reviewed_claims.remaining_review: Root must retain direct .95 optimal-mixture and old-mixture cost identities from CompleteCoreBook. The statement is only about this source mixture family, not arbitrary history-dependent policies.

reviewed_claims.result: CompleteDuality proves feasible-primal≤each-dual, genuine exact-maximizer subgradient inequality, derivative of the scalar Lagrangian, actual closest squared-distance orthant projection and multiplier update sign. Strict violations with positive steps strictly increase the multiplier.
assumptions: Finite number of constraints; nonempty feasible class for primal optimum; bounded Lagrangian image, derived separately from bounded returns; exact inner maximizer for subgradient.
reviewed_claims.remaining_review: The exact-maximizer premise matches the explicit source assumption and is not the desired subgradient conclusion. Attained_reward_dual can convert an all-policy maximum property to the stated equality if required by the source correspondence.

reviewed_claims.result: Both reward-sup convexity and cost-inf concavity are proved over all real multipliers, hence on the nonnegative orthant. Both weak-duality directions are proved at actual optimum level. The mirror relation, exact walkthrough supremum, piecewise max formula, convexity, kink and unique minimizing multiplier are present.
assumptions: Finite-dimensional constraint coordinates; nonempty policy/feasible classes where supremum/infimum used; boundedness hypotheses can be obtained from the proved bounded-return lemmas.
reviewed_claims.remaining_review: Source uses max/min; generic statements use sup/inf and explicit attained-dual lemmas provide the max/min correspondence when the source assumes attainment. No proof of strong duality for arbitrary policies is claimed.
